top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing emergency contact addresses.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Plan for extreme weather conditions (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(G))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational handbook lacked a section on promoting indoor play during extreme weather conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation no longer has  a fenced outdoor area.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §747.5417(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no emergency medical information for transported children.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The most recent inspection report was not posted.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Must Use for Each Child in When Transporting and be Properly Installed (26 TAC §746.5607(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One seatbelt in van #2 that is located on the first row near the window behind the driver's seat was observed broken.

top_violation_types.title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: According to the Texas Comptroller website, the business entity's Franchise Tax Account Status is Inactive/Forfeited. The operation is currently providing care to children with an inactive status.
